about: The mosque's published monthly prayer timetables, newest first. The site shows the entry for the current month (London time); until a month's entry is added it keeps showing the latest earlier one. Used by the Full Timetable pop-up in the prayer banner on every redesigned page, and by the printable timetable on prayer-times.html. Read by js/timetables.js. Add each new month at the top, with the image (JPG) and PDF in documents/; bump the ?v= when a file is replaced.
